env BOLERO_MODULE=on
env sumdb=$BOLERO_SUMDB
env proxy=$BOLERO_PROXY
env BOLERO_PROXY BOLERO_NOPROXY BOLERO_SUMDB BOLERO_NOSUMDB
env dbname=localhost.localdev/sumdb

# disagreeing with the sumdb produces security errors
# (this also populates tiles on the sumdb server).
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
env BOLERO_SUMDB=$sumdb' '$proxy/sumdb-wrong
! bolero get rsc.io/quote
stderr 'bolero: rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2: verifying module: checksum mismatch'
stderr 'downloaded: h1:3fEy'
stderr 'localhost.localdev/sumdb: h1:wrong'
stderr 'SECURITY ERROR\nThis download does NOT match the one reported by the checksum server.'
! bolero get rsc.io/sampler
! bolero get golang.org/x/text

bolero mod edit -require rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
! bolero mod tidy
stderr 'bolero: rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2: verifying go.mod: checksum mismatch'
stderr 'SECURITY ERROR\n'

rm go.sum

# switching to truthful sumdb detects timeline inconsistency
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
env BOLERO_SUMDB=$sumdb
! bolero get rsc.io/fortune
stderr 'SECURITY ERROR\ngo.sum database server misbehavior detected!'
stderr 'proof of misbehavior:'

# removing the cached wrong tree head and cached tiles clears the bad data
rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/sumdb/$dbname/latest
bolero clean -modcache
bolero get rsc.io/fortune

-- go.mod.orig --
module m

go 1.16
-- m.go --
package m

import _ "rsc.io/quote"
